nodes.label: Next.js 16 breaking-changes warning (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: Warns agents that this Next.js version has breaking API/convention/file-structure changes vs training data and to read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ and heed deprecation notices before writing code.

nodes.label: ORIGIN_MEMO missing filter bug (ventas_service.py)
nodes.rationale: Real-time query to INVT_Producto_Movimientos did not filter ORIGIN_MEMO='CLIENTES' like the historical SQL view did, so warehouse transfers were counted as sales, inflating 'Ventas Hoy' 3x. Fixed by adding the same filter.

nodes.label: NaN/Infinity invalid JSON bug (ventas_service.py)
nodes.rationale: Division by zero in real-time computation produced NaN, which Starlette rejected with HTTP 500. Fixed by sanitizing the final DataFrame (.astype(object).where(notna, None)) — casting to object first is required because Series.where(cond, None) on float64 does not store None directly.

nodes.label: Wrong PROD ERP service (SERIALES vs ERICKDEV)
nodes.rationale: Production was pointed at ERP service SERIALES, which lacks INVT_Ficha_Principal, PROV_Liquidaciones_Principal and PROV_Factura_Principal. Switched to service ERICKDEV/REPORTERIA which has them enabled.
nodes.norm_label: wrong prod erp service (seriales vs erickdev)

nodes.label: middleware.ts to proxy.ts migration (Next.js 16)
nodes.rationale: Next.js 16 deprecated middleware.ts, so proxyClientMaxBodySize (100mb->300mb) in next.config.ts was silently never applied. Migrated via the official codemod `npx @next/codemod@canary middleware-to-proxy .`.

nodes.label: nginx client_max_body_size fix
nodes.rationale: aaPanel's default 50m nginx client_max_body_size blocked large Excel range uploads/downloads; raised to 300m and now deploy.py enforces it on every deploy via regex over the vhost conf.

nodes.label: Hardcoded credentials refactor + history purge
nodes.rationale: 14 tracked files had hardcoded credentials; refactored to read from .env/app.config.settings, and git history was purged with git-filter-repo across multiple passes.

nodes.label: dev branch merge-resurrects-purged-files issue
nodes.rationale: An old local copy of dev still has purged files/secrets as ancestors, so a normal `git pull` merge resurrects them even though main and dev share a common ancestor. Fix: `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main` on that dev's machine; to reconcile selectively, cherry-pick only genuinely new files via `git checkout origin/dev -- <file>` then force-push main onto dev.
